# calendar

Drive every gcalcli profile at once — work calendar and personal calendar in a single command.

---

## `calendar_agenda`

Show today's agenda across every configured account.

**Usage**

```sh
calendar_agenda
```

**Examples**

```sh
calendar_agenda
```

**Requires** `gcalcli`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/calendar.sh:50`](../../modules/common/calendar.sh#L50)

---

## `calendar_all`

Run the same gcalcli command against every configured account. Defaults to `agenda`.

**Usage**

```sh
calendar_all [gcalcli-args...]
```

**Examples**

```sh
calendar_all
calendar_all calw
calendar_all quick "lunch with sam tomorrow 12pm"
```

**Requires** `gcalcli`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/calendar.sh:23`](../../modules/common/calendar.sh#L23)
